correctness.rationale: A deleted-product two-dimensional cellular chain proof establishes injectivity of the top boundary using the absence of cycles after removing a unique-cycle edge, then the local forest. Exact equivariant cell-module identities and the graph-cycle chain sequence yield the character in a semisimple rational representation category. An executable finite cellular verifier confirms signed automorphism traces and top-boundary ranks on eight graphs; this is supplemental, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A canonical complete representation formula for arbitrary unicyclic graphs, not just a finite census. Fixed-edge local traces detect nonisomorphic symmetry actions that cannot be extracted from previously known Betti ranks; applies with arbitrary trees, degrees, and asymmetric automorphism groups, and yields all subgroup-invariant dimensions.
